entities.summary: Ayatollah Mohammad-Ali Movahedi Kermani is Tehran's Friday Prayer Ephemeral Imam and the former secretary-general of Combatant Clergy Association. He is also a member of the Assembly of Experts. He is a conservative and principlist politician. Ali Movahedi-Kermani was a theologians & scholars from Kerman (b. 1931, Kerman). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
